Why does popcorn POP? 🍿💥 — Each kernel is a tiny pressure cooker: ~14% water turns to steam until the shell bursts at ~180°C and the starch puffs into foam. #science #popcorn #physics #foodscience #LearnOnTikTok

Octopuses have 3 HEARTS and BLUE blood 🐙💙 — Two hearts for the gills, one for the body — and the body heart STOPS when they swim! Their blood uses copper (hemocyanin), so it's blue. #science #octopus #animals #ocean #LearnOnTikTok

tt:
Why do stars twinkle but planets DON'T? ✨🪐 — Moving layers of air bend starlight (scintillation). Stars are tiny dots so every wobble shows — planets are tiny disks, so the wobbles cancel out. #science #space #astronomy #stars #LearnOnTikTok

Photos: JSC, GSFC (NASA media usage guidelines (generally not copyrighted), NASA Image and Video Library; cropped & graded)
ig:

Camel humps are NOT full of water 🐪 — It's fat! Camels burn it when food is scarce and the hump flops over like a deflated balloon. And a thirsty camel can drink ~114 L in one go! Sources: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance, Live Science #science #animals #camel #desert #LearnOnTikTok
